title: Squamish Jetboat Journeys
specs: Jet boats use internal propulsion allowing safe operation in shallow water and reduced risk to wildlife
Strong focus on safety, engineering, and expedition-level operations
Small-group, high-quality experiences instead of mass tourism
Commitment to sustainability and respectful use of natural areas
Anyone under 16 must wear a suitable life jacket
Must wear inherently buoyant (foam) life jackets; inflatable PFDs prohibited
Private charters available for families, friends, corporate groups, photographers, film crews, and special occasions
Some tours require minimum number of guests; private charters can run with small groups
